name: Sharp Investments Limited
about: Sharp Investments Limited, a non-banking finance company, provides financial services to commercial, industrial, and financial clients in India. The company offers corporate, personal, and working capital loans, as well as loans against shares, securities, and properties. It is also involved in trading in shares and securities and arbitrage business in stock and commodity market, and trade financing. Sharp Investments Limited was incorporated in 1977 and is based in Kolkata, India.
